sources.name: Instagram/Threads/X public signals or Metricool when connected

Technical Operator: execute approved visual generation briefs only

voice_rules.emphasis_limit: maximum 1–2 emphasized words per sentence unless dramatically justified

transition_system.rule: transition must be motivated by shape, object, camera direction, semantic link, time shift, or cause/effect
forbidden_default: hard cut chains with no rhythm

checks: episode has unique thesis and question
visual grammar consistent but shot substance not interchangeable
visual assets pass continuity palette/type/grid check
at least three episode-specific visual motifs
episode uses a unique visual metaphor rather than a repeated scene template
architecture/classical art appears only when narratively justified
generated visual has an approved versioned Visual Generation Brief
generation tool executed the approved brief without material creative rewrite
exactly one official thumbnail concept is selected for generation per episode
thumbnail generation is one job + one prompt version + one independent asset

quality_gates: G5 Script + Independent Fact Check Lock
G6A Visual Generation Brief + Anti-Slop Approval

audio_system.principle: sound is designed with picture, not added after picture

mix_targets_internal_not_platform_requir.dialogue_priority: always intelligible; music automated around speech rather than static gain
mix_targets_internal_not_platform_requir.music_under_dense_dialogue_guideline: typically 12–18 dB perceptually below narration, adjusted by arrangement
mix_targets_internal_not_platform_requir.localized_mix_match: within ±1 LU perceived loudness of Arabic master where practical

anti_patterns: wall-to-wall music with no breathing space
sidechain pumping audible as an effect
SFX louder than key narration without narrative reason
music chosen after final cut with no spotting
same music bed across unrelated episodes

packaging_system.generated_visual_rule: thumbnail concept exploration may occur inside Council deliberation, but exactly one official thumbnail concept may be selected; no generated thumbnail asset may be executed before an approved Visual Generation Brief; one episode thumbnail stage authorizes one brief, one generation job, and one independent asset only

visual_identity.anti_template_rule: no more than two major structural devices may carry over from the immediately previous thumbnail

principles: Use specialized creative tools for creative craft.
Use code for orchestration, validation, metadata, automation, reproducibility and QC.
Never substitute a homemade script for a missing professional craft tool merely because scripting is easier.
If no suitable specialized tool is available, declare CAPABILITY_GAP and stop or escalate.
Generated visual craft requires a versioned Council-authored Visual Generation Brief before tool execution.
Anti-Slop approval is mandatory before generated visual execution.
Generation tools and Technical Operator may not materially reinterpret or creatively rewrite an approved brief.
For episode thumbnail generation, execute exactly one selected Council concept as one job, one prompt version and one independent asset.
Triptych, diptych, contact-sheet, collage and multi-panel thumbnail outputs are rejected.
The primary visual generator is selected by a controlled same-frame same-brief qualification test, not by remaining credits or convenience.
After the visual system is locked, the Council reviews at defined gates; the Visual Art Director owns frame-level visual decisions inside the lock.

ai_video_generation.notes: Runway connected but current workspace exposes no video models; do not pretend video generation is available there.

motion_graphics_compositing.code_role: JSX/automation is allowed to drive After Effects, but After Effects remains the renderer/editor.

picture_edit_finishing.notes: Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve are not runtime-verified on YASSIN. Descript may support rough/text edit but does not by itself close the high-end finishing gate.

audio_edit_mix_master.notes: No Audition or Resolve/Fairlight runtime verification on YASSIN.

tool_policy.escalation_rule: If a required craft stage is blocked, HR/Capability Director must scout or request a specialized tool. The Technical Operator may not fill the gap by authoring a custom craft replacement without an explicit Council exception approved by Owner.
